name: Gratitude & Reflection Meditation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Sit comfortably and take a few deep, settling breaths.
Bring to mind one thing you're grateful for today, picturing it clearly.
Notice how gratitude feels in your body — warmth, lightness, ease.
Silently thank yourself for taking this moment to reflect.
Take a final deep breath before opening your eyes.
